raw_segments.text: Dion, if you would not sow, you pity not the state, nor the remembrance of his most sovereign
Consider little what dangers, by his highness fail of issue, may drop upon his kingdom,
and devour in certain lookers on.
What were more holy than to rejoice the former queen as well?
What holier than, for royalties repair, for present comfort, and for future good, to bless
the bed of majesty again with a sweet fellow to tea?
